UPDATE downloads
            SET status = CASE
                    WHEN status IN ('resolving', 'downloading') THEN 'pending'
                    WHEN status = 'tagging' THEN 'downloaded'
                END,
                next_retry_at = NULL,
                error_message = ?,
                finished_at = NULL,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE id = ?
              AND version = ?
              AND status IN ('resolving', 'downloading', 'tagging')
